public_definitions: The user goal is to review the monthly grid energy dashboard and decide whether May should be handled as a standard low-usage case or escalated as a critical low-usage anomaly for this reporting cycle.
The chart_reference is the monthly grid energy dashboard.
The option_labels are: 'Route May to standard low-usage follow-up', 'Escalate May to critical low-usage anomaly review', 'Send May to background monthly record filing'.
